title: Lightweight Generalized DeepFake Face Detection with WAVIE: Wavelet Augmented Vision Intermediate Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2609.14437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deepfake detection systems often exhibit significant performance degradation when deployed on unseen manipulation methods, limiting their reliability in real-world multimedia environments. This lack of generalization poses critical challenges for misinformation mitigation, digital forensics, and human-centric AI systems. Existing detectors perform well on the forgery methods they are trained on, but their accuracy drops sharply on unseen pipelines. To bridge this generalization gap, we propose WAVIE (Wavelet Augmented Vision Intermediate Embeddings), an end-to-end architecture that combines complementary spatial and frequency cues on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. translated_title: 基于WAVIE（小波增强视觉中间嵌入）的轻量级广义深度伪造人脸检测
translated_abstract: 深度伪造检测系统在应对未见过的篡改方法时往往会表现出显著的性能下降，这限制了其在现实多媒体环境中的可靠性。这种泛化能力的缺乏为虚假信息治理、数字取证和以人为中心的AI系统带来了严峻挑战。现有检测器在其训练所用的伪造方法上表现良好，但在未见过的伪造流程上准确率会急剧下降。为了弥合这一泛化差距，我们提出了WAVIE（小波增强视觉中间嵌入），这是一种在冻结的CLIP骨干网络之上结合互补空间线索与频率线索的端到端架构。WAVIE通过一个轻量级可学习模块对Transformer中间嵌入进行投影，应用三级Daubechies-6（db6）离散小波变换（DWT），在保留高频分支的同时对低频分支进行细化，并通过逆变换重建特征。
tldr: WAVIE提出了一种基于冻结CLIP骨干网络与三级Daubechies-6离散小波变换的轻量级端到端架构，通过融合空间与频率线索，显著提升了深度伪造人脸检测对未见篡改方法的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: WAVIE introduces a lightweight end-to-end architecture built on a frozen CLIP backbone with a three-level Daubechies-6 discrete wavelet transform, fusing complementary spatial and frequency cues to improve deepfake face detection generalization to unseen manipulation methods.
